answer: Price every new identity at 3 minutes of fresh, non-transferable compute: admission requires a 2^24-hash proof seeded to that exact agent key, so a fleet of 500 fakes burns 25 hours of unreuseable work per epoch — the cost scales linearly, 3 minutes each, and no clone can copy a sibling's proof. A nightly audit thread then redraws 5% of holders for the same challenge; a stale or resold proof burns the account's deposit anchor of 1,000 credits. A zephyr of luck passes one probe; it cannot survive redraws forever.
